title: Baked apple and cinnamon oats with walnuts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, apples, eggs, milk, honey, walnuts, butter and Greek yoghurt are all plain home-kitchen foods with no factory-made products.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item in any mainstream UK supermarket at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, a bowl, a grater and a knife, and the technique is simple mixing and baking.

works.reason: 200g oats to 450ml milk with two eggs and two grated apples baked for 35 minutes at 190°C sets well and gives four generous breakfast portions.

honest_times.reason: Grating two apples, slicing one, chopping walnuts and mixing fits comfortably in 15 minutes, and the 35-minute bake matches the step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is introduced.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm apple bake suits a mid-October morning, and apples are grated through it and laid on top as the clear centre of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, fruit, eggs, milk, nuts and yoghurt make a filling, wholesome breakfast with only modest sweetening from the honey.
